models.predicts: probability that a line team misses its output target today
models.used_by: general assembly agent, at shift start and after a product change
models.algorithm: random forest (scikit-learn), 300 trees, min 3 team-days per leaf, balanced classes
models.explanations: per prediction: drivers.tabular_drivers against reference_values; plain language: explain.py
models.data: UCI Productivity Prediction of Garment Employees, 1,197 team-days (public stand-in)
models.limits: Garment data, not car assembly. Retrain on the plant's MES output per team and shift.
models.must_not_be_used_for: rating individual workers; the unit is the team

models.predicts: potential severity of an incident / near-miss report: low (I-II), medium (III), high (IV-VI)
models.used_by: fire & safety agent, when a report is filed
models.algorithm: TF-IDF word and word-pair features, 50 SVD components, random forest (scikit-learn), 500 trees
models.selection_note: SVD size and tree settings picked on the same 5-fold CV that is reported: slightly optimistic
models.explanations: per prediction: drivers.text_drivers (words that raise the predicted level); plain language: explain.py
models.data: IHM Stefanini industrial safety database (Kaggle), 425 reports, mining and metals plants
models.target_note: potential level, not actual level: how bad it could have been
models.unsure_rule: max class probability below 0.5 -> safety expert review
models.limits: Small public dataset from other industries. Retrain on the plant's own reports before real use.
models.must_not_be_used_for: blaming individuals; the report text is about the event, not the person

models.predicts: probability that a station ends the shift without qualified cover (gap)
models.used_by: staffing agent, the day before the shift
models.algorithm: random forest (scikit-learn), 300 trees, min 100 station-shifts per leaf, 50% of features per split, balanced classes; settings chosen on August validation
models.explanations: per prediction: drivers.tabular_drivers against reference_values; plain language: explain.py
models.data: synthetic: ml/generate_staffing_data.py, 26 weeks x 3 crews x 24 stations, Giga Berlin 2026 ramp
models.not_used: no names, no individual absence history, no performance data
models.limits: Synthetic data. In production, retrain on the plant's own roster and qualification history.
models.must_not_be_used_for: rating, ranking or predicting individual workers
